name: @goblin-forge/cli
//: The single-file executable: the whole compiler, the Bun runtime, the
native backend, the prelude and the runtime crate, in one binary.
`bun build --compile` embeds the assets; `node:fs` reads them straight out
of the binary, which is what lets tsc read the prelude without anything
being unpacked. The runtime crate is the exception and is extracted,
because cargo is given a directory and has to find a real one.
